name: eltz-castle
documented_evidence: Castle owner reports eight residential towers up to35m and shows the three family houses, timber frame facades, oriels and dense slate roof landscape. Official pages inconsistently describe a60m or70m rock spur.
modeling_qualifications: Mapped36.1×64.6m core, with secondary heights, oriels and timber panels proportional estimates. Authoritative2024 DGM1 supersedes the coarse production130.92m courtyard and tourism route profile: DHHN2016 courtyard140.389m, side shoulders118–121m, local Elzbach107.5–111.7m. The local rock rises about30m above the river; operator60/70m figures describe broader landscape relief and are not added to the model. A384m measured terrain patch and lower-only cuts restore the narrow spur with64m outer transition. Interpolated DGM beneath occupied roofs is capped at courtyard datum. Water uses DGM river centerline+0.25m estimated depth; this is not a gauge measurement. Final terrain review exposed roofed generic source buildings on the four mapped western ruined fortifications and buried four eastern/southern historic outer houses. These eight mapped parts are now authored: roofless low masonry following DGM, and small slate-roof houses on measured uphill footings. Ruin crest offsets1.6m(walls)/2.4m(towers) and house eaves3.2–5.2m with1.8–3.2m roof rises are proportional estimates, not surveyed elevations. Owner gallery identifies the two outer towers as razed after1336 and names Goldsmith, Craftsmen and Coach House.
